contributions.detail: One inked row, 640.20. Form A's printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS is 640.20 and the cover's line-1 THIS and CUMULATIVE cells are BOTH 640.20 because the LAST cell is 0 - this is the filer's FIRST report of the 2024 cycle, so the period and cumulative scopes COINCIDE. Recorded as cumulative per the addendum. The line-2 '$50.00 or less' aggregate is 0/0/0, so scoring against the over-$50 line and against line1+line2 would give the same figure here; the over-$50 line is the one used.

expenditures.detail: One inked row, 640.20 (Washington County, Filing Fee). Form B's printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES is 640.20 and the cover's line-3 THIS and CUMULATIVE cells are both 640.20 (LAST = 0, first report of the cycle, scopes coincide).

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows 640.20 = printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS 640.20; p3 rows 640.20 = printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES 640.20. Both gate exactly.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 and p3 -> geometry_status ok, 21 bands each (the column headers are printed ABOVE the boxed grid on this print, so bands 1-20 are data rows and band 21 is the TOTAL row). Exactly 1 band carries ink on each page; 1 row emitted per side.

Both sides have a single row, so first-row and last-row crops are the same crop.
gates.balance_chain: 0 + 640.20 - 640.20 = 0, and the cover's line-4 balance-at-end cells read 0 / 0 / 0. Closes exactly. Cross-filing chain: this filing's CUMULATIVE 640.20 is checked against the later 2024-cycle filing 095d57ef in this same chunk - see that record's balance_chain.

escalation_note: 600 dpi cell crops of the p2 and p3 amount boxes (row 1 and the one-pitch-below control) - the transcription-and-verification pass, not a doubt.
notes: index.csv says Tom Durrant / Assessor; the form's handwritten 'Full name of Candidate' reads Tom Durrant and 'Candidate for Office Of' reads Assessor - AGREES. Form generation 2 (county-branded, 'WASHINGTON COUNTY / UTAH' logo variant) with the FOUR-line cover including the '$50.00 or less' aggregate. Cover is handwritten; both schedules are typed. Reporting period Beginning 1/2/24, Ending 6/12/24; signed 6/12/24; clerk RECEIVED stamp JUN 14 2024. Privacy: the cover prints the candidate's street-address/city-state-zip lines (left blank by the filer), his personal email and his phone number - all DISCARDED at read time and written nowhere. Form A's address column was left empty by the filer on the one inked row (an honest blank, not a redaction). Contribution is a self-contribution by the candidate, matched dollar-for-dollar by the filing fee paid to the county.
